study.title: Lightweight Multispectral Crop-Weed Segmentation for Precision Agriculture
study.short_title: 8.7M param transformer-CNN hybrid, WeedsGalore MSI mIoU 78.9

segmentation.domain: crop (maize) vs weed semantic segmentation (3-class background/crop/weed) on multispectral UAV imagery (RGB + NIR + red-edge), with adaptive gated modality fusion
models_tested: Lightweight transformer-CNN hybrid (modality-specific conv encoders + Transformer refinement + Gated Fusion + Pyramid Pooling Module) with MSI input (proposed)
segmentation.best_model: Proposed MSI hybrid: mIoU 0.7888, 8.7 M params (RGB-only variant 0.6308); baselines DeepLabv3+ 0.8290 / 41.2 M, MaskFormer 0.7955 / 43.1 M

dataset.name: WeedsGalore public benchmark (maize crop/weed, Marquardt, Germany)
dataset.note: DJI Phantom 4 Multispectral, 4 flights May-June 2023, 5 m altitude, GSD 2.5 mm/px over ~1840 m2 plot; 156 tiles of 600x600 px. Authors split 109 train / 23 val / 24 test (cell: original WeedsGalore paper uses 104/26/26); multispectral masks remapped to 3 classes (background/crop/weed); underlying annotations cover maize, amaranth, barnyard grass, quickweed, other weeds.

segmentation.backbone: Modality-specific CNN encoders (RGB/NIR/RE streams) + Transformer refinement blocks + Gated Fusion Module (learned modality weights) + Pyramid Pooling Module with skip connections; 8.7 M params total

mIoU.quote: The Multispectral Input (MSI) model, using RGB, NIR, and RE, achieved an mIoU of 78.88%, demonstrating robust segmentation of crop and weed regions. In contrast, the RGB-only variant yielded a lower mIoU of 63.08%
mIoU.section: IV. PROPOSED METHODOLOGY / B. Training and Evaluation
mIoU.ambiguity: 3-class setting (background/crop/weed) on test set (24 tiles). MSI 78.88% vs RGB-only 63.08% (+15.8 pp); quoted baselines on same MSI input: DeepLabv3+ 82.90% (41.2 M params), MaskFormer 79.55% (43.1 M).

PA.ambiguity: Overall accuracy stated as an evaluated metric ('mIoU, per-class IoU, and overall accuracy') but numeric per-class IoU / overall accuracy values not given in text.

edge.framework: AdamW lr 1e-4 + cosine annealing, batch 8, Cross-Entropy + class-balanced focal loss, 100 epochs, mixed precision; hardware not specified

params_M.quote: In contrast, our model achieves 78.88% mIoU with only 8.7M parameters ... suitable for real-time inference on embedded platforms, such as UAV-mounted NVIDIA Jetson devices
params_M.section: IV. PROPOSED METHODOLOGY / A. Model Architecture
params_M.ambiguity: 8.7 M params (Table I, marked 'Edge-Ready: Yes'); deployment on Jetson claimed by design but not measured.

issues: Method architecture (8.7M, multi-modal gated fusion) designed for UAV/edge deployment and labeled 'Edge-Ready: Yes', but NO on-device measurements (FPS/latency/power) are reported on any hardware; edge.reported=false.
Train/val/test split (109/23/24) differs from original WeedsGalore release (104/26/26); both stated in sources.
Per-class IoU and overall accuracy evaluated but numeric values not given in the text.
Quoted MaskFormer baseline mIoU 79.55% vs 80.27% in the original WeedsGalore paper (minor discrepancy).
